0.0: Geez! I can't seem to do anything because of those stupid monkeys! I should have gotten rid of them a long time ago! Why are the village elders so against it? ...Oh, welcome to the #m950100000#! Location guide? Lost and Found? Local product purchase? I have everything you need. What can I help you with?
0.1: Is there a problem? Oh, it's not that big of a deal. It's just that the #o9409011#s are giving me a headache. Many tourists visiting the #m950100000# have been slipping on the #t4000561#s they've been throwing all over the place.
0.2: After turning this place into a tourist attraction and even asking #p9010010# to publicize it, I'm finally starting to see some tourists coming in. But these monkeys are ruining everything! I wanted to rid them from this place, but the village is against it... Sigh, it'd be nice to have some help with this.

yes.0: You'd really want to help me? You're that confident, eh? Well, I'll take all the help I can get! Please eliminate #r100 #o9409011#s#k and bring back #b50 #t4000574#s.
